description: This header defines functions related to constant propagation in Torch's Just-In-Time compiler, including varying modes for dealing with custom classes and non-aliasing operations.

methods.name: ConstantPropagation
methods.description: Performs constant propagation on a given computation graph, with an option to ignore custom user-defined classes.

methods.name: ConstantPropagationImmutableTypes
methods.description: Performs constant propagation only on ops with non-aliasing inputs and outputs.

methods.name: runNodeIfInputsAreConstant
methods.description: Runs a specific node if its inputs are constants, considering non-deterministic ops and side effects.
